findings.title: order() mixin off-by-one for legacy box spec
findings.body: In mixins.scss the order() mixin emits -webkit-box-ordinal-group: $val and -moz-box-ordinal-group: $val with the same value as order: $val. By definition box-ordinal-group is 1-based while order is 0-based, so box-ordinal-group must be order + 1. As written, @include order(3) in header.scss and @include order(2) in topic.scss produce ordinal-group 3/2 instead of 4/3, so legacy -webkit-box/-moz-box browsers order header panel and extra-info-wrapper incorrectly relative to modern flexbox browsers.

findings.title: Invalid -ms-align-items property emitted
findings.body: The align-items() mixin in mixins.scss outputs -ms-align-items: $alignment. That property never existed; IE10/11 only understands -ms-flex-align. The invalid declaration is dropped, so IE10/11 falls back to whatever -ms-flex-align resolves to or stretches, meaning @include align-items(center) in header.scss and @include align-items(baseline) in badges.css.scss do not align as intended in those browsers.

findings.title: float layout ignored inside new flex container breaks small-action
findings.body: In topic-post.scss .small-action is now a flex container via @include flexbox(), so its direct children .topic-avatar, .small-action-desc and button become flex items. Per CSS flexbox, float and clear on flex items are ignored. The code keeps float: left on .topic-avatar and float: right on button with no flex equivalent such as margin-left: auto or justify-content, so the dismiss button that used to be pinned right will now sit immediately after the text and the avatar/text spacing changes.
